shared_elements: hair and beard rendered as regular rows of tight curls/beads
figure(s) arranged along a horizontal register
quadruped animal body with patterned surface treatment
justification: Both surfaces show profile human heads in shallow relief whose hair and beards are rendered as dense regular rows of small curls, a fairly specific shared convention, and both place figures and an animal body along a horizontal register. But the depicted scenes differ: B is an orderly procession of upright attendants leading two horned rams with scale-patterned fleece, while A shows a single head amid sprawling, tumbled bodies and angular forms with no processional order or identifiable led animal.
